title: Oracle-free computation of the limiting random 3-SAT threshold
exact_target: For independent proper uniformly signed random 3-clauses, is there a limiting sharp density $\alpha _3$ and one deterministic finite Turing machine that, on every unary precision input $1^r$, halts with a rational $q_r$ satisfying $|q_r-\alpha _3|\leq 2^{-r}$, using no oracle, advice or noncomputable parameter?
